source: Topic: databases, src/plan/inputs/c4.json (Query plans case 4), PostgreSQL 16.2, Apple M1 Pro, 2026-10-04, median of 5 runs

small.label: Planner's choice: one user's chats
small.sql: SELECT c.id, c.title, count(*) FROM chats c JOIN messages m ON m.chat_id = c.id WHERE c.user_id = 4242 GROUP BY c.id, c.title

small_forced.label: Nested loop switched off
small_forced.sql: SELECT c.id, c.title, count(*) FROM chats c JOIN messages m ON m.chat_id = c.id WHERE c.user_id = 4242 GROUP BY c.id, c.title

large.label: Planner's choice: every chat with its user
large.sql: SELECT u.country, count(*) FROM chats c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id GROUP BY u.country

large_forced.label: Hash join and merge join switched off
large_forced.sql: SELECT u.country, count(*) FROM chats c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id GROUP BY u.country
large_forced.pre: SET enable_hashjoin = off; SET enable_mergejoin = off;

sorted.label: Planner's choice: first 1,000 chats in id order
sorted.sql: SELECT c.id, count(*) FROM chats c JOIN messages m ON m.chat_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1000

sorted_forced.label: Merge join switched off
sorted_forced.sql: SELECT c.id, count(*) FROM chats c JOIN messages m ON m.chat_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1000

large_rpc.label: Planner's choice with random_page_cost = 1.1 (an SSD setting)
large_rpc.sql: SELECT u.country, count(*) FROM chats c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id GROUP BY u.country
